audience.role: Plugin users, upgraders from 0.6.1, and security reviewers evaluating the repaired 0.7.0 candidate

checks.note: README explains fit, install and first run per locale; changelogs record version differences; bilingual release notes carry accurate done/pending acceptance scope; SECURITY.md scopes the risk decision.

A new reader reaches registry and reviewed-source install paths plus a working first-run command in their own locale; three shipped locales with Russian first-class; unchanged by the repair round and re-read against final bytes.
Upgrade terms stay consistent: 0.6.1 runs stay resumable, caches are ignored automatically, and the packaged SKILL.md now states the same migration contract.

Counts are time-scoped (23–24 entries across 2026-11-02 rc.5 scans, one single advisory); the audit repair is nowhere claimed as risk acceptance; publication stays blocked; the single canonical artifact is named with the pre-repair artifact relabelled historical.

Frozen identity (87038935…/c1be1ba6…/226,799 B/29 files) agrees across the identity table, the canonical-artifact section and the repair-round re-verification; GUI gate is required-and-pending everywhere.
Russian README fully translated; Chinese changelog and release-notes sections read independently; the previously noted translation drift (新维护者) is corrected to the maintainer making a new decision.

limitations: Cold read covers reader comprehension of the frozen bytes; the Windows batch, on-screen GUI gates, exact-commit CI and the dependency-risk decision remain separate pending gates.
The release notes reference the candidate acceptance record by its in-repository path; the published Release body will link the path as it exists at the release tag.
